words.trans: 句式：刚才还在A，转眼就B；一会儿A一会儿B，突出变化突然、出乎意料、快速切换。小说叙事和口语对话都很高频
examples: They scrambled blindly down a gully, scraping their shins on bracken one minute, sinking their feet into waterlogged layers of moss the next.

words.trans: n. 落叶松；落叶松木
examples: They were heading for a clump of larch trees that fringed the farm track.

words.trans: v.（非正式）认为、估计、料想（= think，口语高频）
examples: They figured that if they could get that far without being spotted, they would be able to take stock.

words.trans: 短语：盘点存货；评估形势、看清状况再作打算（take stock of the situation）
examples: They would be able to take stock and have a closer look at what was going on.

words.trans: adj. 令人痛苦难熬的、折磨人的（时间/处境难熬）
examples: Close up it presented an agonizing series of obstacles.

words.trans: n. 障碍、阻碍、障碍物
examples: Close up it presented an agonizing series of obstacles.

words.trans: 量词短语：一阵哗啦声（clatter 指金属/石头撞击的连续脆响）；a clatter of stones 石块滚落的哗啦声
examples: They had to hoist themselves over it with a clatter of stones.

words.trans: n. 松鸡（英国山林常见猎禽）；v.【非正式】发牢骚、抱怨（grouse about sth）
examples: A grouse blasted out of some bracken, making Maggie cry aloud with shock.

words.trans: v.（踩进湿泥）咕唧作响、扑哧陷进去；n. 咕唧的湿泥声
examples: Maggie squelched, knee-deep, into a bog.

words.trans: n. 沼泽、泥炭沼泽（boggy 泥泞的）
examples: Maggie squelched, knee-deep, into a bog.

words.trans: 短语：（地形/经济/病情）下降到最低点、到谷底
examples: As the valley bottomed out, Maggie squelched, knee-deep, into a bog.

words.trans: adj. 湿透的、浸饱水的（sodden mosses 吸饱水的苔藓）
examples: She landed with a splash in a mire of sodden mosses.

words.trans: n. 泥潭、泥沼（比 bog 更黏稠的烂泥）
examples: She landed with a splash in a mire of sodden mosses.

words.trans: v. 摸索着走、伸手乱摸；grope one's way out 摸索着从……里爬出来
examples: She groped her way out, now soaked to the skin.

words.trans: 固定短语：浑身湿透、湿到皮肉（= wet through）
examples: She groped her way out, now soaked to the skin.

words.trans: n. 莎草（水边丛生的草）
examples: Joel and Archie had somehow bounded across on tufts of sedge.

words.trans: n.【英式儿童游戏】木头人游戏（音乐停就定住不动；本书用来让无人机误以为是石头）
examples: If a drone heads this way, we need to play musical statues.

words.trans: n. 猛烈、凶狠、强烈、气势
examples: Maggie had never heard such fierceness in her brother's voice.

words.trans: n. 淅沥/噼啪的连续细小拍打声；v. 发出哒哒、淅沥的轻响（patter of water 水声淅沥）
examples: The scream of the drone cut through the patter of water on stone.

words.trans: adj. 刺耳的、穿透性强的；锐利的（piercing scream 刺耳尖啸）
examples: The scream of the drone cut through the patter of water on stone, piercing and urgent.

words.trans: n. 田鼠（体型短粗、短尾，草地路边活动；不是 rat 老鼠、mouse 家鼠）
examples: It was hovering over them like a hawk spying a vole by the roadside.

words.trans: adj. 无情的、毫无怜悯的、冷酷的
examples: As the beam of light began its pitiless journey across the stream...

words.trans: v. 摇晃、摆动（随水流/风摇摆）
examples: Maggie saw the black water illuminated green with weeds swaying in the current.

words.trans: n. 丝绒、天鹅绒；adj. 丝绒般的、柔软黑暗的（the velvet darkness 天鹅绒般的黑暗）
examples: She could have kissed the velvet darkness as the drone passed on at last.

words.trans: 短语：继续前行、一路经过然后离开
examples: She could have kissed the velvet darkness as the drone passed on at last.

words.trans: n. 挤作一团的人群；（橄榄球）争球（in a scrum 挤抱成一团）
examples: They regrouped on the bank, holding on to each other's shoulders in a scrum.

words.trans: v. 转移（注意力/目标）、引开、调开（divert sb from sth）
examples: We can divert them from hunting him and he might just get away.

words.trans: adj. 凶残的、杀人成性的
examples: An absolutely sure way to get caught by murderous criminals ourselves!

words.trans: 短语：接受不愉快的事实、忍受后果、认下它带来的心理负担
examples: We'll always live with the fact that we could have done more.

words.trans: v.（动物）啃食、咬掉（植物顶端）；修剪（sheep-cropped grass 被羊啃短的草）
examples: They made quick progress over the sheep-cropped grass.

words.trans: adj. 有车辙的（rut n. 车轮压出的凹槽；rutted road 布满车辙的路）
examples: Its headlights dancing on the rutted road.

words.trans: n.（英式，尤英格兰北部）山谷、溪谷（比 valley 更乡土，开阔草木茂盛）；dale head 谷头（山谷上端、溪流源头那一头）
examples: Two of the search drones were visible now: one to their left combing the dale head.

words.trans: 短语：山谷的上端/谷头（山谷开始、靠近山坡顶端、溪流发源那一头）
examples: One drone to their left was combing the dale head.

words.trans: 固定短语：斜着、歪着（不水平摆正、不正对路沿）
examples: The yellow dump truck was now parked at a slant on the edge of the track.

words.trans: 短语：有一段距离、老远、不算近；some way from 离某地还有一段距离
examples: The truck was parked on the edge of the track some way from the farm.

words.trans: 短语：猛地停住、戛然停下（= stop abruptly）
examples: When they came level with it, Maggie stopped dead.

words.trans: v.（口语）比……更好、胜过、强过（Sitting by the fire beats standing out in the rain. 坐火边比淋雨强多了）
examples: It has the ignition key in it. This will beat running.

words.trans: v. 预料、预先料到（事情/争论会发生）
examples: Joel held his palms out, anticipating the argument.

words.trans: n. 碰碰车（英式 dodgem car；美式 bumper car）
examples: The only thing you've driven is the dodgems at Blackpool Pleasure Beach.

words.trans: v. 手脚并用地费劲攀爬（爬高处，如卡车驾驶室）
examples: Come on, said Maggie, clambering up to the driver's seat.

words.trans: v. 迂回穿行、绕来绕去（在树/障碍间躲闪前进）
examples: Joel then headed off towards the farm weaving through the larches.

words.trans: n. 模仿、假扮、扮演（刻意模仿他人样子/声音/走姿，让别人误认你就是那人）
examples: His impersonation of Tom's lopsided gait was unmistakable.

words.trans: adj. 歪向一边的、不平衡的（lopsided gait 歪身子的跛行姿势）
examples: His impersonation of Tom's lopsided gait was unmistakable.

words.trans: 短语：径直走到……跟前、走近（up 不一定是地势高，而是朝目标一直走到它面前）
examples: He went up to the gate where there was now only one man on guard.

words.trans: adv. 厚着脸皮地、明目张胆地、肆无忌惮地
examples: Maggie watched him brazenly as the first rays of sun broke across the fell tops behind him.

words.trans: v. 笨重缓慢地移动、蹒跚前行（lumbering weight 笨重的分量）
examples: Despite the lumbering weight of the thing, she was surprised how light the steering was.

words.trans: 短语：慢慢挪出去、小心翼翼地驶出（edge 侧身一点点移动）
examples: She edged out into the track, facing away from the farm.

words.trans: n.（卡车/老式车）侧脚踏板，装在车门下方、车架外侧，底盘高的车踩着才能上驾驶室
examples: The gates opened as Joel pulled himself on to the running board.

words.trans: （英式口语）踩下油门、猛踩加速
examples: Fly, Maggie! Get your foot down.

words.trans: v. 跑得比……更快、甩掉、逃脱（追捕者）
examples: We won't be able to outrun them in this thing, but let's keep going.

words.trans: v.（机器）发出尖锐持续的呜呜啸叫；（人）哭啼抱怨；（小狗）哀鸣
examples: It gathered speed and the engine began to whine.

words.trans: n.（汽车手动挡）离合器
examples: The clutch pedal was so stiff Maggie had to stand up to kick it down.

words.trans: v. 滑行（踩下离合、断开动力后靠惯性向前滑）
examples: The truck coasted for a few terrifying seconds while she wrenched the gear lever across.

words.trans: v. 猛地狂奔、一下子冲出去（多指动物受惊撒腿狂奔，此处拟人写卡车，像赛马般窜出）
examples: The machine bolted away like a racehorse.

words.trans: n. 小片树林、树丛（不大，同类的树；不是广袤 forest）；a grove of trees
examples: Then they were into a grove of trees.

words.trans: adj. 悬垂的、向外伸出吊在头顶上方的（overhanging branches 横伸的枝桠）
examples: In the muffled darkness of the overhanging branches came more shots.

words.trans: 短语：紧跟在后、紧追不舍
examples: The Land Rover was on their tail, the gun pointing at one of the wheels.

words.trans: adv. 愚蠢地、傻乎乎地；莽撞、不计后果地
examples: He stood up, idiotically exposed, his teeth clenched.

words.trans: n. 尖锐刺耳的嘶鸣、尖啸声（此处指急刹车的吱声）
examples: She heard a screech of brakes and something popping behind.

words.trans: v.（车辆）突然转向、猛地拐开、偏离原路线；veer off 突然冲离路面
examples: The Land Rover was veering off the road, careening down a bank.

words.trans: v. 失控地歪着滑行、摇晃横冲直撞（车轮抱死、打滑侧滑前冲）
examples: The Land Rover was veering off the road, careening down a bank.

words.trans: 短语：碾过路面的颠簸凸起（ride the bumps 更常见；本书用 lumps，强调一块块鼓起的硬疙瘩）
examples: The ice cream van was right behind, swaying as it rode the lumps of the road.

words.trans: v.（子弹）跳弹、碰硬物后反弹出去
examples: A shot ricocheted off the steering column.

words.trans: 名词短语：方向盘底下那根金属立柱
examples: A shot ricocheted off the steering column.

words.trans: v. 猛地一晃、突然侧倾
examples: Another hit a tyre, and she felt the machine lurch to one side.
